key_insight: Neural networks discover strongly nonlinear water-wave candidates, while interval arithmetic and Lean turn one candidate’s residual accuracy into an auditable, machine-checked guarantee.
engineering_relevance: The framework links flexible PDE solution discovery with rigorous error control, offering a path toward more trustworthy scientific computation.
method: Train physics-informed neural networks without solution data to learn wave profiles, speeds and, during continuation, surface tension.
Refine candidates to near-machine-precision equation residuals and freeze one as an explicit finite representation.
Certify its uniform residual bound using interval arithmetic, then check deductions from certified bounds in Lean.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports recovery of Stokes waves, Crapper waves and Wilton ripples, new high-amplitude candidates from continuation, and rigorous residual certification for one candidate.
watch_item: A certified small residual does not by itself establish existence or uniqueness of a nearby exact solution, and certification is reported for only one candidate.
paper_title: Rigorously Certified Neural-Network Computation of Nonlinear Water Waves at Near-Machine Precision
